# Built-in 3D models

## robot-expressive.glb
"RobotExpressive" by Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius, https://www.patreon.com/quaternius), released under
CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). Facial expression morph targets and glTF conversion by
Don McCurdy (https://donmccurdy.com/), from the three.js examples
(https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/dev/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive).

Animations: Dance, Death, Idle, Jump, No, Punch, Running, Sitting, Standing, ThumbsUp, Walking,
WalkJump, Wave, Yes. Morph targets (Head): Angry, Surprised, Sad.

## vita.vrm
"Vita", a VRoid Studio β sample model by pixiv Inc., released under CC0 1.0 (the licence is recorded in the
file's own VRM metadata; see https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/articles/4402614652569). VRM 0.x with
expressions a/i/u/e/o (mouth shapes for lip-sync), blink, joy, angry, sorrow and fun, and a humanoid skeleton.

## ren.vrm
"HairSample_Male", a VRoid Studio β sample model by pixiv Inc., shown in DriveDeck as "Ren". Released under
CC0 1.0 (recorded in the file's VRM metadata: licence CC0, allowed user Everyone, commercial use allowed; see
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/articles/4402614652569). VRM 0.x with the same expressions and skeleton as Vita.

## maya.vrm and leo.vrm
"Female_Adult_01" and "Male_Adult_01" from the **Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library**
(https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox), MIT licence, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation; their facial
blendshapes (52 ARKit shapes and 15 visemes) are from the library's HeadBox release. Converted to VRM 1.0 for
DriveGen/StudioGen with Blender and the VRM Add-on for Blender (MIT): biped bones mapped to the VRM humanoid (thighs
re-parented to the pelvis and collarbones to the upper chest), textures reduced to 1024 px, the unused facial action-unit
shapes removed, VRM expressions made from the ARKit shapes, and each ARKit shape added as its own expression ("perfect
sync"). Shown in the app as "Maya" and "Leo".

## seed-san.vrm
"Seed-san" by VirtualCast, Inc. (https://github.com/vrm-c/vrm-specification/tree/master/samples/Seed-san), VRM 1.0,
under the VRM Public License 1.0 (https://vrm.dev/licenses/1.0/): avatar use by everyone, commercial use allowed,
redistribution allowed, **credit required**: Seed-san model by VirtualCast, Inc.

## victoria.vrm, kiko.vrm and noir.vrm
VRoid Studio sample models by pixiv Inc. (the VRoid project): "AvatarSample_G" (Victoria Rubin), "HairSample_Female"
and "AvatarSample_D_Darkness", shown in the app as "Victoria", "Kiko" and "Noir". Released by VRoid under CC0 1.0
(https://opengameart.org/content/vroid-studio-cc0-models, from VRoid's sample model conditions of use). VRM 0.x.
Not part of the app: downloaded on request from Settings › Assistant › Avatars.

## thumbs/
Pictures of the avatars above, rendered in the app.

## elle.vrm (the core avatar)
"Elle Duval (Casual Outfit)" by **NorthrnPoakr**, from VRoid Hub
(https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/1900369427009350078/models/3546657704829426498). VRM 0.x. The author's
conditions of use: avatar use by everyone, modification allowed, redistribution allowed, corporate and personal commercial
use allowed, **credit required**: Elle Duval by NorthrnPoakr (credited in the app's avatar list and here).
